name: Yukiyobanashi
source:
A mysterious incident suddenly takes place in guest hall on a snowy night.
Missing woman, broken glass and red stains splattered around the room ...
Different perspectives will be needed to challenge this mystery.
The screaming persons. The persons who talk to you for some reason.
Sometimes they cooperate, sometimes they conflict, but only this way truth can be revealed.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
雪夜，客房内突然发生神秘事件。
失踪的女人、碎玻璃和红色污渍散落在房间里……
需要不同的视角来挑战这个谜团。
那些尖叫的人。出于某种原因与你交谈的人。
有时他们合作，有时他们冲突，但只有这样才能揭示真相。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
